info.title: stoaix Partner API
info.description:
Machine-to-machine API for integrating external systems (CRM, PMS, etc.) with stoaix platform.

## Authentication
All requests require an API key via `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx` or `x-api-key` header.

API keys are scoped — each key has specific permissions. You can create and manage keys in **Settings > Partner API**.

### Available Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `contacts:read` | Read contacts |
| `contacts:write` | Create, update, delete contacts |
| `leads:read` | Read leads |
| `leads:write` | Create, update leads |
| `appointments:read` | Read appointments |
| `appointments:write` | Create, update appointments |
| `conversations:read` | Read conversations |
| `messages:read` | Read messages |
| `knowledge:read` | Read knowledge items |
| `knowledge:write` | Create, update, delete knowledge items |
| `events:read` | Poll events |
| `inbound:contacts` | Push contacts from external systems |
| `inbound:appointments` | Push appointments from external systems |

> **Note:** Inbound endpoints require dedicated `inbound:*` scopes, not `contacts:write` or `appointments:write`.

## Rate Limiting
All plans: **120 RPM**, **100,000 monthly requests**. Custom plans may have higher limits. Per-key overrides available in Settings > Partner API.

Check `RateLimit-*` response headers:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `RateLimit-Limit` | Max requests per minute |
| `RateLimit-Remaining` | Remaining requests in current window |
| `RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when limit resets |

## Response Headers
Every response includes:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-Api-Version` | Current API version (date-based, e.g. `2026-05-19`) |
| `X-Request-Id` | Unique request identifier for debugging |
| `X-API-Key-Expires` | ISO 8601 expiry date of the API key (if set) |
| `X-API-Key-Expires-In-Days` | Days until key expiry (if set) |
| `RateLimit-Limit` | Max requests per minute |
| `RateLimit-Remaining` | Remaining requests in current window |
| `RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when limit resets |
| `Cache-Control` | Always `no-store` |
| `X-Content-Type-Options` | Always `nosniff` |

## Common Error Responses

All endpoints may return these errors:

| Status | Code | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| 400 | `invalid_json` | Request body is not valid JSON |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization or x-api-key header provided |
| 401 | `invalid_api_key` | Key not found, revoked, expired, or inactive |
| 403 | `insufficient_scope` | API key lacks the required scope for this endpoint |
| 403 | `ip_not_allowed` | Request IP not in the key's allowlist |
| 403 | `org_inactive` | Organization is not active |
| 403 | `feature_not_available` | Partner API not enabled on your plan |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | Request body exceeds 512KB (2MB for batch endpoints) |
| 422 | `idempotency_mismatch` | Same Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | RPM limit exceeded |
| 429 | `monthly_quota_exceeded` | Monthly API quota exhausted |

## Idempotency
POST endpoints accept `Idempotency-Key` header. Responses are cached for 24 hours. Replaying the same key with the same body returns the cached response. Using the same key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_mismatch`.

## Optimistic Concurrency (Version Locking)
PATCH endpoints on contacts, leads, and appointments support optimistic locking via the `version` field. The `version` field is returned in GET responses — include it in your update request. If the record has been modified since you last read it, the API returns `409 Conflict`.

```json
// 1. Fetch current version
GET /api/v1/contacts/uuid → { "data": { "version": 3, ... } }

// 2. Update with version
PATCH /api/v1/contacts/uuid
{ "full_name": "New Name", "version": 3 }

// If version mismatch:
// 409 { "error": { "code": "conflict", "message": "Version conflict — record has been modified. Re-fetch and retry." } }
```

## Pagination
List endpoints use cursor-based pagination. Sort order varies by endpoint:

| Endpoint | Cursor field | Sort order |
|----------|-------------|------------|
| Contacts, Leads, Knowledge | `created_at` | Newest first (descending) |
| Conversations | `updated_at` | Newest first (descending) |
| Appointments | `scheduled_at` | Earliest first (ascending) |
| Messages | `created_at` | Oldest first (ascending) |

Use `next_cursor` from the response as the `cursor` parameter for the next page.

## Webhooks
Register webhook subscriptions in **Settings > Partner API > Webhooks** to receive real-time event notifications.

### Event Types
- `contact.created`, `contact.updated`, `contact.deleted`
- `lead.created`, `lead.updated`, `lead.status_changed`
- `appointment.created`, `appointment.updated`, `appointment.status_changed`

### Delivery & Retry Policy
- **Timeout:** 10 seconds per delivery
- **Retries:** Up to 8 attempts with exponential backoff (immediate, 1min, 5min, 30min, 2h, 6h, 12h, 24h)
- **Dead letter:** After 8 failed attempts, the delivery is moved to `dead_letter` status and an alert is generated
- **HTTP 410:** If your endpoint returns `410 Gone`, the delivery is immediately dead-lettered (no further retries)
- **Auto-disable:** After 10 consecutive failures across deliveries, the subscription is automatically disabled

### Signature Verification
Every webhook includes an `X-Stoaix-Signature` header in Stripe-style format:
```
X-Stoaix-Signature: t=1716048000,v1=5257a869e7ecebeda32affa62cdca3fa51cad7e77a0e56ff536d0ce8e108d8bd
```

To verify:
1. Extract `t` (timestamp) and `v1` (signature) from the header
2. Construct the signed payload: `${t}.${raw_request_body}`
3. Compute HMAC-SHA256 with your webhook secret as the key
4. Compare your computed hex digest with the `v1` value
5. Optionally reject if `t` is more than 5 minutes old (replay protection)

```javascript
const crypto = require('crypto');

function verifyWebhook(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret) {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(
    signatureHeader.split(',').map(p => p.split('='))
  );
  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(parts.t + '.' + rawBody)
    .digest('hex');
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
    Buffer.from(parts.v1),
    Buffer.from(expected)
  );
}
```

### Polling Fallback
If your system cannot receive webhooks, use `GET /api/v1/events` to poll for changes. Events are retained for 30 days.

## State Machine (Status Transitions)
When `enforce_state_machine` is enabled for your organization, status updates are validated:

### Lead Status Transitions
```
new → in_progress, lost
in_progress → nurturing, qualified, handed_off, lost
nurturing → in_progress, qualified, lost
qualified → handed_off, converted, lost
handed_off → qualified, converted, lost
lost → new (reactivation)
converted → (terminal)
```

### Appointment Status Transitions
```
scheduled → confirmed, cancelled, rescheduled
confirmed → attended, no_show, cancelled, rescheduled
rescheduled → confirmed, cancelled
no_show → rescheduled
cancelled → rescheduled
attended → (terminal)
```

Invalid transitions return `400` with code `invalid_transition` and an `allowed` array listing valid target statuses.

get.description: Returns contacts sorted by `created_at` descending (newest first). Requires scope: `contacts:read`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, phone, email (max 100 chars)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor (`next_cursor` from previous response, a `created_at` timestamp)

post.description: Creates a new contact. At least one of `full_name`, `phone`, or `email` is required. If a contact with the same phone already exists, returns `200` with `{ "data": { "id": "uuid", "deduplicated": true } }` instead of creating a duplicate. Requires scope: `contacts:write`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate creation

200.description: Deduplicated — existing contact found by phone

patch.description: Supports optimistic locking via `version` field. Requires scope: `contacts:write`.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a contact by setting `deleted_at`. Cascades: open leads → `lost`, scheduled appointments → `cancelled`. Triggers `contact.deleted` webhook. Requires scope: `contacts:write`.

post.description: Process up to 100 contact operations. `create` skips if duplicate found; `upsert` updates the existing record. Dedup field is set via `match_on` (default: `phone`). Always returns HTTP 200 — check `summary.failed` for per-item errors. Requires scope: `contacts:write`.
Starts an async export. Poll `GET /api/v1/export-jobs/{jobId}` for results. Export includes contact, leads, appointments, and conversations with messages. Requires scope: `contacts:read`.

get.description: Poll export job. When `status=completed`, `result` contains: `{ contact, leads[], appointments[], conversations[], exported_at }`. Expired jobs return `410 Gone`. Requires scope: `contacts:read`.
Returns leads sorted by `created_at` descending (newest first). Requires scope: `leads:read`.

post.description: The `contact_id` must belong to your organization. Requires scope: `leads:write`.

404.description: Contact not found in this organization

patch.description: Supports optimistic locking via `version`. If `enforce_state_machine` is enabled, invalid status transitions return `400` with allowed targets. Requires scope: `leads:write`.

get.description: Returns appointments sorted by `scheduled_at` ascending (earliest first). Requires scope: `appointments:read`.

post.description: Creates with `status: scheduled` regardless of any status value in the body. `contact_id` and `lead_id` (if provided) must belong to your organization. Requires scope: `appointments:write`.

404.description: Contact or lead not found in this organization

patch.description: Supports optimistic locking via `version`. If `enforce_state_machine` is enabled, invalid status transitions return `400`. Requires scope: `appointments:write`.

post.description: Process up to 100 operations. Dedup for upsert uses `external_id`. Always returns HTTP 200 — check `summary.failed` for per-item errors. Requires scope: `appointments:write`.

get.description: Returns conversations sorted by `updated_at` descending (most recent activity first). Requires scope: `conversations:read`.
Returns messages sorted by `created_at` ascending (oldest first). Requires scope: `messages:read`.
Returns all knowledge items (including deactivated ones). Sorted by `created_at` descending. Requires scope: `knowledge:read`.

post.description: An embedding vector is automatically generated from title+content using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small. Requires scope: `knowledge:write`.

patch.description: If `title` or `content` changes, the embedding is automatically re-generated. Requires scope: `knowledge:write`.

get.description: Returns events since a given timestamp. Use `cursor` from the response as the next `since` value. Events are retained for 30 days. **Note:** This endpoint returns a different envelope than other list endpoints. Requires scope: `events:read`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only events after this time are returned.

post.description: Dedup via `external_id` + `partner_name` stored in `channel_identifiers` JSONB: `{ "partner_name": "external_id" }`. Returns `action: 'created'` or `action: 'updated'` in response. Requires scope: `inbound:contacts` (not `contacts:write`).

Dedup via `external_id`. Unlike `POST /appointments`, this endpoint accepts `status` for new records. Returns `action: 'created'` or `action: 'updated'`. Requires scope: `inbound:appointments` (not `appointments:write`).

BearerAuth.description: API key as Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx`

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key as custom header: `x-api-key: sk_live_xxx`

channel_identifiers.description: External system IDs, e.g. { "novasoft": "ext_123" }. Present in detail responses.

version.description: Record version for optimistic locking. Present in detail and update responses.

ContactCreate.description: At least one of `full_name`, `phone`, or `email` is required.

phone.description: E.164 or local format (auto-normalized). Returns `400 invalid_phone` if unparseable.

ContactUpdate.description: At least one field is required.

version.description: Current version for optimistic locking. If provided and does not match, returns 409 Conflict.

method.description: `create` — skip if duplicate; `upsert` — update if duplicate found

id.description: Record ID (present when action is created/updated/deduplicated)

poll_url.description: Relative URL to poll for results

LeadUpdate.description: At least one field is required.

status.description: Subject to state machine validation if enabled

collected_data.description: Must be a JSON object (not array)

external_id.description: External system ID (used for batch upsert dedup). Note: ignored in regular POST, only used in batch and inbound.

source.description: Origin system (platform, ai, ghl, dentsoft, api)

AppointmentUpdate.description: At least one field is required.

partner_name.description: Partner identifier. Must match `^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` (lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

status.description: Unlike regular POST /appointments, inbound accepts status

EventList.description: Note: Events use a different response envelope than other endpoints (`events` array instead of `data` + `pagination`).

next_cursor.description: Use as `cursor` parameter for next page. Null when no more results.

allowed.description: Valid target statuses (only present for invalid_transition errors)

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key (`missing_api_key` or `invalid_api_key`)

error.message: API key lacks required scope: contacts:write

Conflict.description: Version conflict (optimistic locking). Re-fetch the record and retry with the current version.

error.message: Version conflict — record has been modified. Re-fetch and retry.

InvalidTransition.description: Invalid status transition (state machine). The `allowed` array lists valid target statuses.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded (`rate_limited`) or monthly quota exhausted (`monthly_quota_exceeded`)
